instrument_name: 26 MRSA 664 Minimum wage; overtime rate
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: 664(1): minimum wage indexed each 1 January by the Aug-to-Aug % change in CPI-W Northeast Region, increase rounded to nearest 0.05 USD; follows any higher federal minimum. 664(2): tip credit max 50% of the minimum wage (direct cash wage >= 50%), advance notice items A-F, 7-day workweek check; tips charged to card paid by next regular payday, no card-fee deduction. 664(2-A) tip pooling. 664(3): 1.5x regular rate for hours over 40 in a week; regular rate per FLSA 207(e); exemptions incl. auto mechanics/parts clerks/service writers/salespersons, mariners, public employees except State executive/judicial branch, agricultural/fish processing list.

instrument_name: Maine DOL Minimum Wage poster 2026 (rev. 10/25)
authority: Maine Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Standards
figure_or_rule_carried: Agriculture and non-agriculture minimum wage 15.10 USD/h effective 2026-01-01; overtime-exempt minimum salary 871.16 USD/week from 2026-01-01; 'Statements to Employees': with each payment of wages a statement showing date of pay period, hours worked, total earnings, itemized deductions; records kept 3 years.
verification_method: wayback-copy 20260401034059 of official PDF, read locally (PyMuPDF)

instrument_name: Maine DOL Minimum Wage poster 2027 (rev. 9/26)
authority: Maine Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Standards
figure_or_rule_carried: Minimum wage 15.10 USD/h from 2026-01-01; increases to 15.70 USD/h on 2027-01-01 (agriculture and non-agriculture); overtime-exempt minimum salary 905.79 USD/week from 2027-01-01 (3000 x 15.70 / 52 = 905.77; poster figure differs by 0.02, see open question).
verification_method: wayback-copy 20260918235958 of official PDF, read locally (PyMuPDF)

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 621-A Timely and full payment of wages
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Pay at regular intervals not exceeding 16 days, all wages earned to within 8 days of payment date (family members and salaried employees excepted); payday on a closed day -> next business day; established day made known, interval increase needs 30 days written notice; pay-rate decrease effective next working day with prior notice; no fee for direct deposit (direct deposit into account designated by the employee).

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 663(3) Definitions: exempt employees
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Salaried exempt (executive/administrative/professional) only if annualized pay exceeds 3000 x State minimum hourly wage or the FLSA annualized rate, whichever is higher; agriculture excluded from the minimum-wage subchapter except farms with over 300,000 laying birds; family members residing with and dependent on the employer excluded.

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 665(1) Powers and duties of commissioner: records and pay statement
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: PAY STATEMENT REQUIRED (corrects the absence finding of US-ME-P5-1-004 / US-ME-P5-2-006, which searched only ch.7 sub-ch.2): employer keeps hours and wages records at least 3 years and furnishes with each payment of wages a statement showing date of the pay period, hours, total earnings and itemized deductions; direct deposit/electronic transfer -> accurate record of the transfer with the same items when the transfer is made; electronic format allowed if the employee has ready access and can print without cost.
verification_method: inspected directly (statute text read); second independent authority: MDOL poster US-MES5-002

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 626 Cessation of employment
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Leaving employee paid in full no later than the next established payday (no discharge/resignation distinction); 'reasonable time' on demand = earlier of next regular payday or 2 weeks after demand; unused paid vacation accrued under employer policy on/after 2023-01-01 paid at cessation unless employer has 10 or fewer employees or is public (CBA supersedes); deductions: overcompensation per 635 and written-signed loans/advances; violation = unpaid wages + interest + 2x liquidated damages + fees.

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 637 Earned paid leave
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers with more than 10 employees for more than 120 days in a calendar year: 1 hour paid leave per 40 hours worked, up to 40 hours per year of employment, any purpose; use may be deferred until 120 days of employment; unused hours carry over (PL 2025 c.438: carry-over does not reduce next-year accrual up to 40 h or policy cap); paid at base rate; seasonal industry excluded; municipal preemption; CBA exception. No payout-on-separation clause in the section.

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 598-A Prospective employee's social security number
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer may not request an SSN on an application or during the application process (except substance-use testing or pre-employment background check); after hire allowed.

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 625-B Severance pay due to closing, substantial shutdown or relocation of a covered establishment
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
article_or_section: 625-B (definitions, (2) severance, (6) notice to director, (6-A) notice to employees and municipality)
figure_or_rule_carried: Covered establishment = facility employing 100+ persons in the preceding 12 months. Closing or mass layoff: severance of one week's pay per year of service (partial pay for partial year), week's pay = gross earnings of the last 12 months / weeks with earnings (gross earnings include regular pay, shift differentials, premiums, overtime, holidays, sick and vacation pay); paid within one regular pay period after the last full day of work, in addition to final wages. Notice 90 days before closing/relocation to the director and to employees and municipal officers; mass layoff notice within 7 days; fine 500 USD/day.

instrument_name: MRS 2026 Withholding Tables for Individual Income Tax (revised Dec 2025): percentage method detail, Form W-4ME rules, W-2 filing, worked examples
authority: Maine Revenue Services
article_or_section: Front notes; instructions 5, 6, 9, 10, 11; Percentage Method 2026 steps 1-6 and Examples 1-3
figure_or_rule_carried: Supplements US-ME-P5-2-001 (same file): withholding standard deduction 12,450 single (annualized wage <= 102,250) / 27,750 married (<= 204,550), phased out linearly to 0 at 177,250 / 354,550 (12,450*(177,250-wage)/75,000; 27,750*(354,550-wage)/150,000, rounded to 4 decimals); allowance 5,300 each; pay-period factors 52/26/24/12/260; married schedule 5.80% below 54,850, 3,181 + 6.75% to 129,750, 8,237 + 7.15% above; result per period rounded to nearest dollar. Examples 1-3 (oracle) reproduced in Python: 0 / 33 / 257 USD per week. No valid W-4ME -> single, zero allowances; copy of W-4ME to MRS when IRS demands the federal W-4 or a non-Maine-address employee claims exempt and expects >= 5,000 Maine-source pay; Allowance Variance Certificate needed to claim more allowances. W-2/1099 data filed electronically with MRS by 31 January (paper not accepted; Maine Tax Portal bulk file upload specifications); W-2 to employees by the federal due date, terminated employees on written request within 30 days. 941ME quarterly, due last day of month after quarter, electronic. Backup withholding: flat 5%. Penalties: late payment 1%/month max 25%; late filing greater of 25 USD or 10%; W-2 failure 50 USD each. Do not reduce Maine withholding for federal W-4 Step 4(b) deductions.
verification_method: inspected directly (local file re-read 2026-11-02); derived arithmetically (Examples 1-3 reproduced)

instrument_name: City of Portland Code of Ordinances Chapter 33 Minimum Wage (rev. 11-4-2025, referendum 2025-11-04)
authority: City of Portland, Maine
figure_or_rule_carried: Work within Portland city limits: 16.75 USD/h from 2026-01-01 (City of Portland's own employees from 2026-07-01); 17.75 USD/h from 2027-01-01; 19.00 USD/h from 2028-01-01; from 2029-01-01 indexed by Aug-to-Aug CPI-U Northeast, rounded to nearest 0.05; follows the State rate if higher. Tip credit no greater than half the city minimum (cash wage at least 8.375, i.e. 8.38 rounded up - derived); emergency-proclamation work paid 1.5x the city minimum (not telework). Employee definition excludes 26 MRSA 663(3) exemptions. Host: CivicPlus asset of the city code PDF (PDF metadata title 'Chapter 33 Minimum Wage', created 2026-01-08); link from portlandmaine.gov not re-verified.

instrument_name: 14 MRSA 3126-A Installment payments (creditor wage garnishment limit)
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Maximum weekly earnings subject to a (non-support) installment order: least of (A) 25% of disposable earnings plus exempt income, (B) the amount by which that sum exceeds 40 x the higher of the federal or State minimum hourly wage, (C) total disposable earnings. 2026: 40 x 15.10 = 604.00 USD/week protected (derived; CCPA uses 30 x 7.25 = 217.50).
verification_method: inspected directly (statute text read); derived arithmetically (40 x 15.10)

instrument_name: 14 MRSA 3127-B Order to employer or payor of earnings
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer served with order to withhold and answer: answer within 20 days (form answer computing disposable earnings), withhold lesser of the installment amount or the 3126-A maximum until satisfied; employer fee 1 USD per check forwarded, deducted from the amount withheld; failure to answer = employer liability; no discharge because of the order.

instrument_name: 19-A MRSA 2306 Immediate withholding of earnings (child support)
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Administrative child-support withholding order: amount includes 2 USD per week in addition to the support amount; payor begins withholding immediately when earnings are usually paid and remits to DHHS within 7 business days after each withholding, with the support enforcement case number; payor may combine remittances if separately designated; support withholding has priority over any earlier non-support attachment, garnishment or assignment. 19-A MRSA 2370: employer processing fee only if set by DHHS rule (rule not read).

instrument_name: 19-A MRSA 2154 Employment information (new-hire reporting)
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer doing business in Maine reports each newly hired employee (resides or works in Maine; never employed before, or rehired after 60+ consecutive days of separation) to DHHS within 7 days of first services for remuneration: employee name, address, SSN, date of birth, first date of services; employer name, address and employment security reference number or unified business identifier. W-4 copy or agreed electronic means. Independent contractors anticipated >= 2,500 USD in a year also reported within 7 days (name, address, SSN...). Stricter than the federal 20 days.

instrument_name: 26 MRSA ch.15 Public works prevailing wage: 1303, 1304, 1311
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Coverage: construction of public works funded in whole or part by State funds with a contract of 50,000 USD or more (1304 'public works'); 'construction' excludes contracts under 10,000; also 'assisted projects' (renewable/energy projects >= 2 MW with State assistance, bids from 2023-01-01). Wage and benefit rate not less than the fair minimum rate determined by the Bureau of Labor Standards (1308); fine >= 250 USD per employee violation per day. 1311 certified payroll: contractor and each subcontractor keep records (names, occupation, hours, job title, hourly rate, wages paid, incl. independent contractors) at the job site, retain 3 years after contract end, and file a copy MONTHLY with the public authority/assisting agency.

instrument_name: 36 MRSA 111(1-A) Definitions: Code (IRC conformity date)
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: 'Code' = Internal Revenue Code of 1986 and amendments as of 2025-12-31 (fixed-date conformity): federal exclusions (401(k), 125, HSA, 132(f) transit, group-term life) flow into Maine income unless 36 MRSA 5122 modifies them (5122 not read this pass). Withholding booklet: Maine does not follow the federal W-4 Step 4(b) deductions.

instrument_name: 36 MRSA 5403 Annual adjustments for inflation
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: On or about 15 September each year MRS indexes, for the next tax year, the income tax rate-table brackets (chained CPI, 12 months to 30 June vs base year 2015/2016), the standard deduction (base 2017) and the standard/itemized deduction phase-out thresholds; personal exemption indexed under 5126-A (not read). Publication: the next-year withholding tables booklet.

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 1043 Employment Security Law definitions (wages, employment, exclusions, localization)
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
article_or_section: 1043(1),(9),(11) incl. A-2, A-3, E-F localization, exclusions; (19)
figure_or_rule_carried: UI taxable wage base 12,000 USD per calendar year per employee per employer (fixed in statute, not indexed); wages paid by the same legal entity in ANY OTHER STATE count toward the 12,000 (1043(19)); predecessor wages count. Wages include commissions, bonuses, severance, gratuities, non-cash remuneration. Localization test (localized / base of operations / direction or control / residence). Coverage: agricultural labor if 20,000 USD wages in a quarter or 10+ workers in 20 weeks (crew-leader rules); domestic service if 1,000 USD in a quarter; exclusions: H-2A agricultural aliens, school co-op students, student nurses/interns, newspaper delivery under 18, service for own child or spouse and child under 18 for a parent, ministers and members of religious orders, religious/charitable 3306(c)(8) organisations below the 4-worker rule.

instrument_name: Maine DOL Form ME UC-1 Quarterly Unemployment Contributions Report: 2026 instructions (rev. 02/09/2026)
authority: Maine Department of Labor, Bureau of Unemployment Compensation
figure_or_rule_carried: ME UC-1 due on or by the last day of the month after each calendar quarter; electronic filing via ReEmployME recommended (paper UC-1 otherwise; file-format specification published); line 1 monthly employment for the payroll period including the 12th; wage base 12,000 with excess-wage example; UC rate reduced by the CSSF rate; CSSF 0.14% of taxable wages; UPAF stated as 0.16% (CONFLICT with 0.17% in the 2026 rate array US-ME-P5-1-001 / US-MEP7-002 - see open question); reimbursable employers exempt from CSSF/UPAF; interest 10% p.a. from 2026-01-01 compounded monthly; late payment 1%/month max 25%; late report greater of 25 USD or 10% (25% after 60 days from demand); employers must give separating employees the Employment Security Law notice (poster copy).
verification_method: wayback-copy 20260521070429 of official PDF, read locally (PyMuPDF)

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 1167 Unemployment Program Administrative Fund
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: UPAF rate = predetermined yield = ratio of total wages to taxable wages (1221(6)(L)) x planned yield 0.04% of total wages, rounded to the nearest 0.01%. Supports a rate-year-specific figure (0.17% in the 2026 array) over the 0.16% printed in the UC-1 instructions; the 2026 ratio itself was not read.

instrument_name: Maine DOL Tax Rate Notice FAQs (01/2026)
authority: Maine Department of Labor, Bureau of Unemployment Compensation
figure_or_rule_carried: CSSF and UPAF are shown separately for transparency; the total combined rate is what the employer pays. No percentage stated.
verification_method: wayback-copy 20260710203433 of official PDF, read locally (PyMuPDF)

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 850-F Paid Family and Medical Leave premiums (full text, local copy)
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Premium and contribution reports remitted quarterly from 2025-01-01; premium not more than combined 1.0% of wages from 2025-01-01; from calendar year 2028 the department sets the rate annually by 1 October (solvency formula); employer 15+ employees: may deduct up to 50% of the premium from wages and remits 100%; fewer than 15: may deduct up to 50% of the premium and remits 50% (i.e. remits 0.5% and may recover it all from the employee); premiums apply up to the SSA contribution and benefit base; approved private plan exempts; failure = assessment of 1.0% of total annual payroll plus benefits paid. Read with US-MEP6-001 (FAQ: 2025-2027 joint rate 1% / 0.5%).

instrument_name: Maine DOL PFML Employer FAQ (July 2026): wage definition, locality, tax treatment, W-2 Box 14
authority: Maine Department of Labor, Paid Family and Medical Leave
figure_or_rule_carried: Supplements US-MEP6-001 (same local file, re-read 2026-11-02): FAQ 6 locality of wages = the Maine UI localization test (multistate workers follow UI); premiums computed on total subject wages before taxes, employee share withheld AFTER federal and state taxes (does not reduce taxable wages); employer-paid employee share is additional taxable wages (IRS RR-25-04); W-2 Box 14 label 'MEPFML' for employee contributions; missed employee premiums during leave may be deducted retroactively (PFML rule section X(L)); penalty for late contributions/reports 1% of the employer's total quarterly payroll; quarterly wage reports and payments through the PFML portal; third-party payroll designation in the portal.

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 622 Records
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer keeps a true record of date and amount paid to each employee and a daily record of time worked (except salaried employees under 663(3)(K)); accessible to the department. Retention period: 3 years under 665(1).

instrument_name: 36 MRSA 5122 Modifications to federal adjusted gross income (individual)
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Keyword search of the full text read 2026-11-02 (health savings / section 223 / 125 / 132 / transit / dependent care / tips / overtime): NO addition modification for HSA, cafeteria-plan, transit or 401(k) exclusions, so Maine follows the federal wage exclusions under the 111(1-A) fixed date (assessment-level modifications only). Subtractions of payroll interest: employer student-loan payments to a lender for qualified hospital health-care employees (from 2020) and FAME-administered student-loan repayment programs (from 2022) - assessment level, not withholding. Pension deduction rules (401(a)/403/457(b)) are retirement-income items, out of payroll scope.

instrument_name: 26 MRSA 774 Hours of employment (minors)
authority: Maine Legislature, Office of the Revisor of Statutes
figure_or_rule_carried: Minors 16-17 enrolled in school: max 50 h/week when school not in session, 24 h/week when in session (50 h in weeks with < 3 school days or first/last week), 10 h/day off-session, 6 h/day in session (8 h on last school day of the week), max 6 consecutive days, not after 10:15 p.m. before a school day/midnight otherwise, not before 7 a.m. on school days/5 a.m. otherwise. Under 16: max 40 h/week off-session, 18 h/week in session, 8 h/day off-session, 3 h/day in session (further limits in 774(2)). Hours limits only; minimum wage applies in full (no youth sub-minimum in 664).
